stack.runtime: go runtime (single static binary, no CGO)
stack.database: sqlite via modernc.org/sqlite (pure-Go, no CGO) + JSON columns (json_extract, generated columns)
stack.codegen: protoc 29.3 -> proto/mellifera/{common,scanner,metadata,plugin}/v1/*.pb.go (committed; buf not installed, protoc fallback used)
external_runtime_deps: ffprobe 7.1.1 (via os/exec arg slice ONLY; never sh -c)
stack.test: go test (table-driven test per exported symbol)
stack.linter: golangci-lint v1.64.8 (.golangci.yml: funlen 60/40, gocognit 15, gocyclo 15, lll 120, dupl 100, depguard denies reflect + DI frameworks, govet, ineffassign, misspell)

conventions: max 8 exported symbols per package (12 hard fail) — scripts/check.sh counts
doc.go per package (contract-first; the entire public API in one file)
pure core / thin shell (logic = pure functions; I/O only at store/plugin/stream/api/janitor edges)
api handlers are pure delegation: parse request -> call ONE domain function -> write response (no branching, no orchestration)
no DI framework, no reflect (golangci depguard denies both)
flat main.go constructor wiring (the entire app graph readable in one file)
data-type boundaries (structs); interfaces only at the plugin seam with >=2 implementations (never single-impl interfaces)
no shared mutable types across packages (cross-package data crosses a struct conversion)
table-driven test per exported symbol (tests are the spec AND the acceptance gate)
parameterized SQL only (no string-built queries) — golang-security skill
dependency direction points DOWN only: api -> scan -> {module, plugin} -> store (scan inserted between api and {module,plugin}); proto/ and pkg/sdk are shared leaves; no cycles
Apache-2.0 license headers on every .go file (D12/Q18); DCO Signed-off-by, no CLA
prefer deprecation over deletion (reserved fields, additive proto changes)
precision: exact per-source values namespaced and preserved (no over-rounding, no source destroys another's data)
Russian-language data is first-class (no English-only assumptions baked in)
complexity budget: file warn >300 / fail >500 lines; outgoing intra-core deps warn >4 / fail >6 per package; a failed check means redesign, not relax

src_layout: proto/mellifera/{common,scanner,metadata,plugin}/v1/ — gRPC contracts verbatim from arch §2; generated *.pb.go + *_grpc.pb.go committed (protoc 29.3; buf absent)
pkg/sdk/ — plugin SDK (5): Serve, ScannerPlugin, Scanner, HandshakeConfig, Capability; ships in the MAIN module for MVP (R7)

internal/store/ — SQLite documents + control tables + reserved tables; 11 WARN: Open, Close, DB, CreateLibrary, GetLibrary, GetItem, PutItem, QueryItems (+ Store/Item/Library). DB() shares *sql.DB with module (seam S10). RecordProgress/GetResume DEFERRED (arch §9.1)

internal/plugin/ — subprocess lifecycle + gRPC clients + capability routing; 9 WARN: Open, Load, Start, Stop, Status, Scanner (+ Manager/Deps/Health). Typed Scanner(pluginID,capID) accessor + Status (replaces generic Call/Health); §7.3 restart (arch §2.2, §7.3)
internal/module/ — config-driven module registry; 6: Open, Get, List (+ Registry/Module/ScannerBinding). Read-only param SQL via store.DB() (arch §2.4)
internal/scan/ — scan-side orchestrator (NEW): Run, Deps, Result. GetLibrary->module->scanner->stream->identify->PutItem (3 symbols; arch §3.1 doc)
internal/api/ — chi router, pure delegation, zero logic; 3: New, Deps, Principal. Deps.AdminToken injects the middleware token
internal/enrich/ — queue + dispatch Match->Build->Convert->Merge (DEFERRED — not built this feature)
plugins/base-scanner/ — subprocess binary (MAIN module for MVP) using pkg/sdk: walk + ffprobe arg-slice + TV filename parse + withinRoot path guard (serves scanner.v1 + plugin.v1)
cmd/mellifera/ — flat main.go constructor wiring; env: MELLIFERA_ADMIN_TOKEN (req), MELLIFERA_DATA_DIR, MELLIFERA_BASE_SCANNER, MELLIFERA_LISTEN
integration_test.go + qa_*_test.go — AC-1 golden e2e + independent QA acceptance/regression (stdlib-only black-box)
FOUNDATIONAL SLICE SHIPPED: scan-library implemented all of the above except the 3 deferred packages (enrich/stream/janitor)
